description: Call one read op of a cell running on one of your own devices (from my_cells), with JSON in and JSON out. Only ops that read (their right ends in :read or :health) for now; the call carries only that right, so the cell itself refuses anything more. Needs a signed-in connection; see whoami.

args.description: the request as JSON; leave out for an op that takes nothing

device.description: your device's name from my_devices, or the start of its node key

name: cell_call
title: Call a cell on your device
